rcS_env_file.description: Path to optional environment configuration file sourced at boot.

mount_points.description: List of filesystems to mount during early boot.

hostname.description: System hostname to set during boot. Leave empty to skip hostname configuration.

mode.description: 'auto' (leave to NTP/hardware), 'manual' to set specific time.

datetime.description: Date/time string (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS') for manual mode.

modules.description: List of kernel modules to load at boot.

swap_devices.description: List of swap devices/files to activate.

fsck_force.description: Force filesystem check even if filesystems appear clean.

mode.description: 'clean' removes all contents; 'size_limited' trims oversized files.

max_size_mb.description: Maximum size (in MB) for files in /tmp when using 'size_limited' mode.

sysctl_params.description: List of sysctl key=value pairs to apply (as 'key=value' strings).

default_runlevel.description: Default SysV runlevel (e.g., '2' for multi-user, '5' for GUI). Ignored on systemd systems unless in compatibility mode.

s_scripts.description: List of scripts in /etc/init.d/ to execute with 'start' argument before runlevel switching.

use_sysv_init.description: If true, attempt to switch to the default runlevel after initialization (only on SysV-only systems).
